name: Razorpay

webhook.algorithm: X-Razorpay-Signature; HMAC-SHA256 hex over the RAW request body keyed with the webhook secret (a dashboard-chosen value, NOT the API key secret). Signature does NOT cover a timestamp, so there is no tolerance window to enforce. Razorpay's documented replay strategy is event-id dedup via the x-razorpay-event-id header (unique per event). VERIFIED from razorpay.com/docs/webhooks/validate-test/.

fees.notes: 2% + 18% GST on most domestic methods (cards, UPI, netbanking, wallets), no setup fee, no AMC; charged only on successful transactions. International cards priced higher (quoted, not published). VERIFIED from Razorpay's own 2026 pricing pages.

notes: India is the single largest gap in the shipped set: Stripe is invite-only and international-only in India, so no shipped provider can take a domestic INR payment. Razorpay is the default answer for Indian devs and is the only one in this cluster with first-class Subscriptions + UPI AutoPay + card e-mandate APIs under one SDK.
SDKs: node: razorpay (official, ships validateWebhookSignature(body, signature, secret)); python: razorpay; php: razorpay/razorpay; also official Java/.NET/Ruby.
Developer-experience scores are unrated placeholders (3/3); they are not used in ranking.
Overlaps: Overlaps nothing shipped. Razorpay's Malaysian arm is Curlec (acquired 2022) — a separate MYR entity, not the same API surface; treat MY support as partial.
